name: Palette Design System Icon Library
summary: Open-source icon set from the Palette design system, with copy-SVG and download for each icon.
description: A small open-source icon library that lists 24 icons by name (airpods, battery, beer, bolt, car, chef-emoji, cloud, moon, sun, train and so on), each with copy-SVG and download actions. The page says new, randomly generated icons are added over time to keep the collection growing.
contains: copy SVG and download per icon
open-source, ever-growing collection updated with new icons
icons named after everyday objects: battery, beer, bolt, car, moon, sun, train, yin-yang
